subject: Regional training blocks & contingency plan for Clearline onboarding
messages:
From: Alice Grant <alice.grant@clearlinehealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Clearline onboarding — scheduling EU/US sessions (week of Jul 12)

Hi Jonas / Marissa / Ben,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the latency numbers and the console walkthrough. Were ready to schedule the hands-on onboarding (console + API) for our EU ops and a separate session for our US engineering team.

Constraints: our EU team is only available in CEST mornings (09:00-12:00 CEST) the week of July 12; US eng prefers late-morning ET (11:00-14:00 ET) that same week. We also have a compliance kickoff on July 13 that may make July 13 unavailable for senior staff.

Can you propose a couple of blocks that work for your trainers? Id like to include our training_ops inbox (cc) and will attach a quick availability sheet. Also can you confirm:
- If the session can be split into a 90-minute console walkthrough + 60-minute API deep-dive
- Who would be the backup host if our primary contacts need to reschedule
- Whether sessions will be recorded and a link shared

Attachment: clearline_availability.xlsx (availability matrix)

Thanks,
Alice Grant
Senior Implementation Manager
Clearline Health
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Alice Grant <alice.grant@clearlinehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, training_ops@clearlinehealth.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Clearline onboarding — scheduling EU/US sessions (week of Jul 12)

Hi Alice,

Appreciate the availability file — makes this easier. We can definitely split the onboarding into a 90m console walkthrough followed by a 60m API enablement lab. Proposed approach:

- EU session (recorded): Tue, Jul 13, 09:30-11:00 CEST — console walkthrough (90m) + 11:15-12:15 CEST — API deep-dive (60m)
- US session (recorded): Thu, Jul 15, 11:00-12:30 ET — console walkthrough (90m) + 12:45-13:45 ET — API deep-dive (60m)

I note your comment about a compliance kickoff on the 13th — if senior folks are in that meeting we can move the EU session to Wed, Jul 14 AM CEST. Please confirm which day is preferable.

Backup hosts: Marissa will lead the EU session; Ben will be the backup/secondary for both sessions and can step in for API lab. Im attaching our onboarding prep checklist and will include a short runbook for access and test tokens.

Attachments: redwood_onboarding_prep_checklist.pdf

Next steps: if Thu 15 for US and Tue/Wed for EU look good I will send calendar invites and a short pre-read to the recipients listed in the availability sheet.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Director, Customer Solutions — Redwood Inference
From: Alice Grant <alice.grant@clearlinehealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: training_ops@clearlinehealth.com
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 07:18:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Clearline onboarding — scheduling EU/US sessions (week of Jul 12)

Hi Jonas / team,

Quick update from our side: the compliance kickoff was bumped into the morning of Jul 13 and several of our EU ops leads will be tied up. Wed prefer Wed, Jul 14 for the EU block (09:30-11:00 & 11:15-12:15 CEST).

A few additional asks:
- Please mark the API deep-dive to include token rotation and data retention settings (our security team asked).
- Wed like the session recorded and shared to an internal folder; can you provide the recording link within 48 hours?
- If Ben is backup, can he be a co-host on the invites so he can start the session if Marissa is pulled into something else?

Well confirm attendee list next week and share any dietary requirements for the in-person portion (some folks will join from the office).

Thanks,
Alice
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alice Grant <alice.grant@clearlinehealth.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, training_ops@clearlinehealth.com
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Confirmed: EU session moved to Wed Jul 14 + US session Thu Jul 15 (recording & backup)

Hi Alice — great, thanks for the heads up.

Ive moved the EU block to Wed, Jul 14 (09:30-11:00 CEST console; 11:15-12:15 CEST API). US block remains Thu, Jul 15 as proposed. Ive created calendar invites and added Ben as co-host on both so he can start/host the API lab if needed.

Recording: we will record both sessions and upload the MP4s to a shared Drive folder; link will be sent within 24–48 hours after each session.

Security addendum: Ben will cover token rotation and retention settings during the API deep-dive and will attach the short security checklist to the post-session notes.

Attachments included in invite: meeting-invite-EMEA.ics (EU invite), redwood_onboarding_prep_checklist.pdf

HubSpot: Ive linked the invites to CL-2027-0458 and added the pre-read to the Drive folder here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cOnboardingKit.

If anything changes Ill ping here; otherwise well see you on Jul 14 / Jul 15.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Customer Solutions Lead — Redwood Inference
